text: Keddie c02/c03/c10 me se c03 aur c10 bana diye — munh hilta hai, voiceover ke saath, QA pass, storage par upload ho gaye. Lekin c02 video pipeline ne block kar diya (policy check), wapas try karna mana hai isliye task transfer kar diya hai — c02 koi aur worker ya agla run bana le. Baaki do file IDs result me likh diye hain.
